user.title: Nous Research
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the Nous Research inference API. Create an API key at portal.nousresearch.com and paste it below.

data_description.api_key: Key from portal.nousresearch.com. It is sent as a Bearer token and stored in the config entry.
data_description.base_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Keep the default unless you route requests through a proxy.
data_description.name: Name of this integration entry.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Nous Research
reauth_confirm.description: The API key was rejected by the Nous Research API. Enter a new key from portal.nousresearch.com.

model.title: Choose a model
model.description: Pick the chat model this entry should use. The list comes from the model catalog of the configured endpoint; you can also paste any other model ID.

data_description.chat_model: Model ID exactly as reported by /v1/models, e.g. vendor/model-name.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

error.no_credits: The account has no credits left.
error.rate_limited: Rate limit reached. Try again in a moment.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Nous Research API.
error.model_required: Choose a model from the list or paste a model ID.

init.title: Nous Research options
init.description: Tune the agent behaviour, cost tracking and catalog refresh.

data_description.prompt: Instructions prepended to every conversation. Leave empty to use the built-in assistant prompt.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Expose Home Assistant entities and services to the model as tools.
data_description.chat_model: Model used for new conversations. Existing entities keep their model until reloaded.
data_description.max_tokens: Upper bound for the completion, thinking tokens included.
data_description.temperature: Sampling temperature. 0.2-0.5 works well for control tasks.
data_description.reasoning_mode: How thinking is triggered. See the README for the exact prompt.
data_description.cost_sensors: Create the cost and token sensors for this entry.
data_description.budget_usd: Monthly budget used for the budget remaining sensor. 0 disables it.
data_description.catalog_interval: How often the model catalog and prices are refreshed.

auth.message: Authentication failed. Check the API key.

no_credits.message: The Nous Research account has no credits left. Top up at portal.nousresearch.com.

rate_limit.message: Rate limit reached. The request was not sent.

api.message: The Nous Research API returned an error.

structured_error.message: The model returned a structured response that could not be parsed.

image_unsupported.message: The selected model does not accept images.

reset_usage.name: Reset usage
reset_usage.description: Clear the locally tracked cost and token counters for a Nous Research entry.

unknown_model.title: Model not in catalog
unknown_model.description: The configured model `{model}` is not offered by the API catalog. Open the integration options and pick a model, otherwise every request fails.
